spans.s: शौट्(ऋ)शौटृ r. 1st cl. (शौटति) To be proud.

शौटीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Proud, haughty.
 m. (-रः)
 1. A hero.
 2. An ascetic,
one who abandons the world.
 3. A proud or haughty man, but of
low tribe or occupation, an upstart.
 E. शौट् to be proud, and इरन्
Unādi aff.; also as derived from शौड the same, शौडीर; also the
short vowel being substituted for the diphthong, शुटीर ।

शौटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं)
 1. Heroism, prowess.
 2. Pride, arrogance.
 E. शौटीर a
hero, and ष्यञ् aff.
